historical_boundary_and_administrative_n.Ladakh: Formed as a separate Union Territory on 31 October 2019 following the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019. In 2018, Ladakh was not a separate reporting entity and was included in Jammu and Kashmir. 2018 is recorded as null/NA (not zero).
historical_boundary_and_administrative_n.Dadra_and_Nagar_Haveli_and_Daman_and_Diu: The two Union Territories of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu were merged into a single Union Territory effective 26 January 2020. For consistency with the unified administrative boundary, figures for 2018-2021 are reported as the unified sum of both constituent territories.
historical_boundary_and_administrative_n.Estimations_by_Ministry: In the 2022 official reporting (Table 5.1.2 and Table 4.1.2), figures for Maharashtra and Delhi are officially estimated by the Ministry of Tourism by applying the All-India 2022/2019 growth rate to their 2019 base data, as footnoted in the publication.
